notes.title: Small Balance Update
notes.notes:
~In case you missed the announcement this small patch is for the following:

~For the first 3 story missions enemy stats will be adjusted from 1 to 0.5, and bosses will be adjusted from 1 to 0.75. This means they will deal 50% of current attack power and have 50% of health for normal enemies.

~Credits received for these first 3 story missions will also be reduced by 50%

notes.title: Pre-Launch Update
notes.notes:
~These fixes are for both the demo build and will be implemented into the full version.

-Dusk Counter on perfect dodge has been increased from 1 to 3 seconds

-Increased mobility on most Left and Right Weapon skills, aswell as Artemis Heat Skills

-Improved Stagger mechanic

-Added Codex

-Fixed enemy hp bug
This bug was doubling enemy hp, but due to it going unnoticed gameplay was balanced with this in mind so overall every enemy has lost 75% hp.

-Fixed currency not saving

-Added in combat attire for units, aswell as made improved the character models

-Lowered the size of VFX on certain ranged weapons

-Condensed subsystem amount for cleaner UI and a less intense feel
Subsystem UI was always abit too much, so I've condensed it to only list the important ones.

notes.title: 10/11/22 Small Update
notes.notes:
[b]This update is for the demo build which includes:[/b]

-Improvements to the tutorial, aswell as an option for replaying said tutorial. This also includes explanations for using the subsystem menu, how dialogue works, and the codex system.

-Indicators to represent dialogue that has not been seen yet

-The codex, (that isn't fully implemented yet) although it cannot be accessed atm.

Next update will most likely be the last for the demo, and it will most likely stay the same unless something happens once Grave Queen releases. Anywho, next update is focused on updating playable character models and completing the codex system.
